title: The plan in five numbers
headline: We propose a ฿2,760 million gross ceiling for FY2027; the base case misses our financial objective (F1), and net-new money is released after each gate.

tiles.label: Net-new spend, each year

tiles.label: Extra revenue, FY2027E base
tiles.note: Team assumption; ฿696m FY2028E vs ฿933m needed

tiles.label: FY2027E growth; goal is 7.0%
tiles.note: Margin 34.6% vs our 35.5% floor: also missed

body.ask: Most new effort goes to Gen Z and young adults (18–29). The base case misses F1; only the optimistic target meets it.

notes: One: a proposed gross ceiling of 2,760 million baht. Two: net-new spend, 560 million a year. Three: our base case adds 328 million, then 696 million; repaying 560 million a year needs 933 million. Four: growth of 6.6 percent against 7.0 and margin of 34.6 against our 35.5 floor miss our objective, F1. Only the optimistic case, a target by definition, meets it. Five: money is released after each gate. Our second speaker covers the situation.
